sources.purpose: UUID v4 generation for entity IDs to replace collision-prone Date.now() timestamps
sources.snippetHash: N/A - built-in API, no code copying required
sources.integrationNotes: Replace Date.now().toString() with crypto.randomUUID() at lines 41 and 81 in src/storage.ts. Requires adding 'import crypto from "crypto";' at top of file. No external dependencies needed as this is Node.js built-in from v14.17.0+.

sources.purpose: Input validation patterns for user-provided strings (goals, todos, plans)
sources.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (documentation/pattern reference only - no code directly copied)
sources.snippetHash: N/A - pattern-based clean-room implementation, not direct code reuse
sources.integrationNotes: Implement validation functions following OWASP best practices: string length checks (1-500 chars for goals, 1-5000 for descriptions, 1-200 for titles), whitespace trimming, numeric range validation (0-10 for complexity), type checking. This is a pattern-based implementation guided by OWASP principles, not copied code. The actual implementation is original work.
sources.notes: OWASP documentation is used as a reference for security patterns. No actual code from OWASP is used. Our implementation is original but follows industry-standard validation practices as documented by OWASP.
